name: Oc hut
summary: The culture office names ốc hút at the Don An Phú festival and does not say which snail or how it is cooked. ZaloPay describes a spicy plate of small apple snails with lemongrass, chili, garlic, and coconut water.
howToEat: The culture office lists các loại ốc hút among festival snacks and prints no method.
ZaloPay: small apple snails cooked with lemongrass, chili, garlic, and coconut water, eaten with a pick or by sucking, in the late afternoon and after rain.
No price was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The festival ground is south of cầu Cổ Lũy. ZaloPay names no street.
seoDescription: The culture office names ốc hút at the don festival and prints no method. ZaloPay describes spicy apple snails. Price and hour are Check on arrival.
